name: KOGI Korean BBQ
notes: Photo 1 was a drink-only beverage chalkboard, skipped. Photos 2 and 3 are the same printed AYCE (all-you-can-eat) tier menu photographed twice; merged. This is an AYCE format with one price per tier covering a fixed list of included meats, so each tier is recorded as one dish with the included items in the description; the separately listed 'Unlimited Sides' (rice, kimchi, soups, etc.) are free inclusions, not priced items, and were omitted per the modifier/add-on rule.
